definitions.gloss: traffic volume; amount of traffic; traffic flow
definitions.explanation: The quantity of vehicles or pedestrians passing through a given point or area. Used in transportation planning, road management, and everyday descriptions of how busy a road is.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{交通量|こうつうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦{時間帯|じかんたい}→時間帯：12971_jikantai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{交通量|こうつうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Traffic volume increases during the morning commute.

examples.japanese: {交通量|こうつうりょう}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of a traffic volume survey, it was decided to install a new traffic signal.

notes:
{交通量|こうつうりょう} measures the volume of vehicles or pedestrians passing through a given point. It covers both car traffic and foot traffic depending on context.

FORMS:
⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧ (traffic) + ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (quantity). A straightforward compound noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交通量|こうつうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ / ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ (heavy / light traffic)
- {交通量|こうつうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧ / ⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧ (traffic increases / decreases)
- {交通量|こうつうりょう}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (traffic volume survey)
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交通量|こうつうりょう} (daily traffic volume)

USAGE:
Frequent in news reports, urban planning documents, and everyday conversation about road conditions. Often paired with ⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧/⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ rather than ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧/⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧: traffic jam (the result of high {交通量|こうつうりょう})
- {通行量|つうこうりょう}: passage volume (more formal/technical synonym)
